Jerry Seinfeld is headed to Las Vegas in 2027 with a brand new residency at the Encore Theater at Wynn.
The comedian will kick off a string of 12 performances just before the Super Bowl, from Feb. 11 to Feb. 13, before returning for a weekend in June and another weekend in October.
Tickets to all shows go on sale at ticketmaster.com on Friday, Oct. 30, at 10 a.m. PT. Related Stories ‘It: Welcome to Derry’ Surprise Halloween Episode Drops on HBO Max
‘It: Welcome to Derry’ Surprise Halloween Episode Drops on HBO Max
To announce the new residency, Seinfeld filmed a series of vignettes throughout Wynn Las Vegas enthusiastically declaring, “I have a residency, I’m a resident!”
“On behalf of AEG Presents and Wynn Las Vegas, we couldn’t be more thrilled to welcome Jerry Seinfeld to Encore Theater,” said Bobby Reynolds, senior vice president of AEG Presents Las Vegas. “Jerry is one of the most renowned names in comedy, and we look forward to bringing his signature stand-up to audiences in such an intimate setting.”
Aside from co-creating and starring in the hit sitcom that borrows his last name, Seinfeld is known for his stand-up specials, which include the 1998 HBO hour “I’m Telling You for the Last Time” and the Netflix tapings “Jerry Before Seinfeld” (2017) and “23 Hours to Kill” (2020). He also created and hosted the popular web series “Comedians in Cars Getting Coffee,” wrote “Bee Movie” and was the subject of the 2002 documentary “Comedian.”
